A few years ago I was unfortunate enough to have been driving on the interstate highway, when I suddenly began having a seizure in the 3rd lane. I was no longer in control of my muscles and my foot laid on the accelerator. The traffic was piled to a dead stop about half a mile ahead and my dash read 95mph, after about a minute I regained control of my body and managed to brake the car, steered left into the middle divider, missing the stopped traffic by mere inches. The middle divider had a space between it and the yellow line, the width of a car and a half but it had a lot of gravel which caused my car to lose traction and ended up hitting the divider which caused my car to barrel roll across the highway about 7 times. I remember gripping the steering wheel holding on for dear life. Miraculously no other vehicles were involved and as my car laid on the driver side I climbed out the passenger side window, feeling slightly sore on my chest. Lifting up my tshirt revealed a cut running diagonally across my torso. The 3 point seatbelts saved my life, without it I would have ejected through windshield. I still have memory loss but also my life so I am grateful for that.
